import json,urllib.request
RPC='http://127.0.0.1:8545'
FACTORY='0x5C69bEe701ef814a2B6a3EDD4B1652CB9cc5aA6f'
WETH='0xc02aaa39b223fe8d0a0e5c4f27ead9083c756cc2'

def rpc(method, params):
    body=json.dumps({'jsonrpc':'2.0','id':1,'method':method,'params':params}).encode()
    req=urllib.request.Request(RPC, data=body, headers={'Content-Type':'application/json'})
    return json.loads(urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=20).read())['result']

def call(to, data):
    return rpc('eth_call', [{'to':to,'data':data}, 'latest'])

length=int(call(FACTORY, '0x574f2ba3'), 16)
print('allPairsLength', length)
found=0
for i in range(length-1, max(-1, length-80), -1):
    idx=hex(i)[2:].rjust(64,'0')
    pair='0x'+call(FACTORY, '0x1e3dd18b'+idx)[-40:]
    t0='0x'+call(pair, '0x0dfe1681')[-40:]
    t1='0x'+call(pair, '0xd21220a7')[-40:]
    reserves=call(pair, '0x0902f1ac')
    r=reserves[2:]
    r0=int(r[0:64],16); r1=int(r[64:128],16)
    if t0==WETH:
        eth, tok, token = r0, r1, t1
    elif t1==WETH:
        eth, tok, token = r1, r0, t0
    else:
        continue
    if eth < 2*10**17:
        continue
    found += 1
    print(f'pair={pair} token={token} weth={eth/1e18:.4f} tok={tok}')
